title: Retrieval augmented generation
text: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) retrieves relevant documents to provide context for a language model. Retrieved context helps ground generated answers in source material.

title: TF-IDF scoring
text: TF-IDF combines term frequency with inverse document frequency. Rare terms receive more weight than terms shared across many documents.

title: Cosine similarity
text: Cosine similarity compares the angle between two vectors. In text retrieval, document and query vectors are compared to rank relevant documents.

title: Python testing
text: Python includes unittest in its standard library. Unit tests check expected behavior and help catch regressions when code changes.

title: Growing tomatoes
text: Tomatoes grow best with sunlight, regular watering, and well drained soil. Gardeners can use compost to improve soil nutrients.
